svg.aria-label: Memory during next build. Before: compilation runs in the main process, its 5.5 GB is still held when linting and type checking add about 2 GB, and the build crosses the 8 GB limit. After: compilation runs in a build worker that releases its memory when it finishes, so linting and type checking start from a low baseline.
